title: Robot Championship
statementMd:
Fran and Sofia have become huge fans of robot aura fights, so they have decided to create their own robot aura tournament. Since Sofia is a great expert on robots, Fran will need your help to win the championship.

A match of the tournament takes place on an $n \times n$ board. The rows are numbered from **bottom to top** and the columns from left to right, so $(1, 1)$ is the bottom-left corner and $(n, n)$ is the top-right corner. The opponent's robot is hidden at some unknown cell $(i, j)$ and moves once every second, but you do not see it.

At the beginning of each second $s$, before the robot moves, you must choose an integer $v$ with $2 \le v \le 2n$ and shoot a laser along the diagonal

$$\{\, (r, c) \mid r + c = v \,\}.$$ The laser touches the robot if the robot is currently on a cell of that diagonal, in which case you win immediately. Otherwise, after your shot, suppose the robot is currently at $(r, c)$, the robot moves to one of the following cells, provided the move stays inside the board:

- up: $(r + 1, c)$;
- right: $(r, c + 1)$;
- down-left: $(r - 1, c - 1)$.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/76c8fb5da81a03caa0f7e955b4dd790574238278.png) *The robot is at cell $(3,2)$ (its diagonal is $r+c=5$). The green laser is the diagonal $v=7$, which does not touch the robot.*

The robot is adversarial: it may start on any cell, and it may choose any valid sequence of moves. You have to output a fixed sequence of at most $3n$ diagonals $v_1, v_2, \ldots, v_k$ such that, no matter where the robot starts and no matter how it moves, at least one of the lasers is guaranteed to touch it at some second during the tournament.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 44$). The description of the test cases follows.

The only line of each test case contains a single integer $n$ ($2 \le n \le 100$) — the size of the board.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n^3$ over all test cases does not exceed $10^6$.

## Output

For each testcase, print two lines. The first line contains an integer $k$ ($1 \le k \le 3n$) — the number of lasers.

The second line contains $k$ integers $v_1, v_2, \ldots, v_k$ ($2 \le v_i \le 2n$) — the diagonals in the order they are shot.

You may print any valid sequence.

## Note

For $n = 2$, the sequence $3, 3, 3$ works. The first laser $3$ removes the diagonal $r + c = 3$ (cells $(1, 2)$ and $(2, 1)$). Cell $(1, 1)$ must move onto that same diagonal on the next turn, and cell $(2, 2)$ is forced to follow the path $(2, 2) \to (1, 1) \to$ the same diagonal. The second and third lasers catch both.

For $n = 3$, the sequence $4, 4, 4$ works. A robot on the diagonal $r + c = 4$ is hit by the first laser. From the diagonal $r + c = 3$ or from cell $(3, 3)$, every move leads onto $r + c = 4$, so the second laser hits it. From cell $(1, 1)$ or from the diagonal $r + c = 5$, every move leads onto $r + c = 3$ or to cell $(3, 3)$, so the third laser hits it.
statementZhMd:
Fran 和 Sofia 都成了机器人气场对战的狂热粉丝，于是决定创建自己的机器人气场锦标赛。由于 Sofia 是机器人方面的专家，Fran 需要你的帮助来赢得锦标赛。

比赛在一个 $n \times n$ 的棋盘上进行。行号按 **从下到上** 编号，列号按从左到右编号，因此 $(1, 1)$ 是左下角，$(n, n)$ 是右上角。对手的机器人藏在某个未知的单元格 $(i, j)$ 中，并且每秒移动一次，但你看不见它。

在每秒 $s$ 开始时、机器人移动之前，你必须选择一个满足 $2 \le v \le 2n$ 的整数 $v$，并沿着如下对角线发射激光

$$\{\, (r, c) \mid r + c = v \,\}.$$

如果机器人当前位于该对角线上的某个单元格，激光就会击中机器人，此时你立即获胜。否则，在你射击之后，设机器人当前位于 $(r, c)$，它会移动到以下单元格之一，前提是移动后仍在棋盘内：

- 向上：$(r + 1, c)$；
- 向右：$(r, c + 1)$；
- 左下：$(r - 1, c - 1)$。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/76c8fb5da81a03caa0f7e955b4dd790574238278.png) *机器人位于单元格 $(3,2)$（其所在对角线为 $r+c=5$）。绿色激光是对角线 $v=7$，不会击中机器人。*

机器人是对抗性的：它可以从任意单元格开始，也可以选择任意有效的移动序列。你需要输出一个长度不超过 $3n$ 的固定对角线序列 $v_1, v_2, \ldots, v_k$，使得无论机器人从哪里开始、无论它如何移动，都能保证在比赛期间的某一秒至少有一束激光击中它。

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 $t$（$1 \le t \le 44$）。接下来是各个测试用例的描述。

每个测试用例仅包含一行，其中有一个整数 $n$（$2 \le n \le 100$）——棋盘的大小。

保证所有测试用例的 $n^3$ 之和不超过 $10^6$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出两行。第一行包含一个整数 $k$（$1 \le k \le 3n$）——激光的数量。

第二行包含 $k$ 个整数 $v_1, v_2, \ldots, v_k$（$2 \le v_i \le 2n$）——按照发射顺序排列的对角线编号。

你可以输出任意有效序列。

## 说明

对于 $n = 2$，序列 $3, 3, 3$ 有效。第一束激光 $3$ 会排除对角线 $r + c = 3$（包含单元格 $(1, 2)$ 和 $(2, 1)$）。位于单元格 $(1, 1)$ 的机器人下一回合必定会移动到同一条对角线，而位于单元格 $(2, 2)$ 的机器人被迫沿着路径 $(2, 2) \to (1, 1) \to$ 同一条对角线移动。第二束和第三束激光会将它们捕获。

对于 $n = 3$，序列 $4, 4, 4$ 有效。位于对角线 $r + c = 4$ 上的机器人会被第一束激光击中。从对角线 $r + c = 3$ 或单元格 $(3, 3)$ 出发时，每一步移动都会到达 $r + c = 4$，因此第二束激光会击中它。从单元格 $(1, 1)$ 或对角线 $r + c = 5$ 出发时，每一步移动都会到达 $r + c = 3$ 或单元格 $(3, 3)$，因此第三束激光会击中它。
